title: Tears of Guthix (quest)
start: Talk to Juna, inside the cave under Lumbridge Swamp.

ironman.t:
49 Crafting or
 50 Quest points for Lorehound's pet items, which includes unlimited bullseye lanterns

items.t: This can be obtained from the Lorehound with the 50 quest point upgrade
A rope, if it is your first time accessing Lumbridge Swamp Caves, and you are not accessing it through the Lumbridge Castle entrance.
This can be obtained from the Lorehound with the 50 quest point upgrade

recommended.t: 36 Thieving and Death to the Dorgeshuun for alternative lantern source
49 Crafting, if you wish to make your own lantern. You don't need these levels to replace the lens by a sapphire in an existing bullseye lantern.
Unlocking the swamp shortcut during The Lost Tribe for ease of getting to Juna.
Starting The Lost Tribe to access the Lumbridge Swamp Caves through the Lumbridge's kitchen tunnel and having a lit sapphire lantern can be used to avoid the other items required.
Spiny helmet/Slayer helmet to negate damage from wall beasts.

rewards.t: Ability to play Tears of Guthix once a week
Ability to make an ornate bowl for increased experience with 80 Mining and Crafting
Tears of Guthix teleport option on the games necklace

steps.t: Use a cut sapphire on an oil filled bullseye lantern.
Travel to the dark hole under tree slightly north west of the water altar in Lumbridge Swamp.
Climb down the hole to access Lumbridge Swamp Caves.

sub.t: If this is your first visit, Use the rope on the tree.
Recommended: Equip a spiny helmet/slayer helmet to negate damage from wall beasts, or use a movement ability like Surge or Dive to prevent the wall beasts from attacking.

steps.t: Run to the south east end of the cavern.
Jump-across the stepping stone to the south (see shortcut icon on the map shown)
Dismiss all followers and un-equip items held in hand.
On the north side of the cavern near the entrance, Right-click travel across cavern on a light creature.
Jump the cliff to the east.
Run north and talk to Juna [Chat: 1 Okay... › Accept]

sub.t: If you've already completed The Chosen Commander. [Chat: 4 So I'm an enemy of the gods now? › ~ › 1 Okay... › Accept]
If you completed World Wakes [Chat: 2 I'd like to talk about something else. › 1 Okay... › Accept]

steps.t: Craft the magic stone into a stone bowl.

get_inside.text: Teleport directly to the Lumbridge Swamp by using an Enlightened amulet.
Teleport directly to the Lumbridge Swamp by using a 'Chipped' Lumbridge teleport or Dave's spellbook.
Teleport to Lumbridge lodestone and go south through Lumbridge cemetery.
Teleport to Al Kharid lodestone and go west through Al Kharid jetty.
Teleport to the water altar through the Abyss.
